contexts.text: There flashed from their eyes the fire of lust for the sex...
Cause that the companionships between the sexes are the heavenly sweetnesses themselves, which are pure.
With one of the sex. CL 44:6.
In cold towards their wives, and in heat towards the sex.
They were then in a state of loathing for the sex.
Without instruction man would not know how to discriminate sex, and nothing whatever about the ways of loving it.
That in each sex there has been implanted from creation the faculty and inclination to be conjoined as into a one. Explained.
This sphere is received by the female sex, and, through this, is transferred into the male sex. Explained.
With the male sex there is no conjugial love, but it is solely with the female sex.
It is from the transference of this sphere from the female sex... that the mind is inflamed by mere thought about the sex.
(By betrothing) the universal love towards the sex is determined to one man or one woman of the sex.
Their souls separate themselves from the unlimited love of the sex...
Cold towards the sex (with confirmed adulterers), and at last loathing. CL 453. CL 505:end.
This lust (of varieties) is love, and at the same time loathing, for the sex. Explained.
In (plants) there are not two sexes; but every one is male.
That the sexes are not to be confounded. Signified.
